stories.headline: Josh Jacobs Gets Pulled Off the Trail Indefinitely, and Green Bay's Backfield Turns Into Open Country
stories.read: Hold up there, pardner, because this one moves your whole board. The league dropped Josh Jacobs on the Commissioner's Exempt List Sunday over two misdemeanor charges out of May, which means no practices, no games, no timetable, and his first court date ain't till November. Marshawn Lloyd inherits the reins in Green Bay, and the Packers moved fast enough to trade a 2028 sixth to Pittsburgh for Kaleb Johnson to back him up. Lloyd is the single richest piece of unclaimed territory on the range this mornin', so if he's sittin' free in your outfit, spend everything you got and stake him before the saloon opens.

stories.headline: Christian Kirk Hits the Injured List After All, and Doc Eats a Little Crow on Yesterday's Tip
stories.read: Well now, I told you yesterday to go stake Christian Kirk and the trail bent on me overnight. That calf he tweaked back in July never came around, so San Francisco parked him on injured reserve with a designation to return, which means four games minimum before he rides again. Those throws don't vanish into thin air, though, and rookie De'Zhaun Stribling just climbed a rung on the pecking order with Pearsall already shelved for the year. Kirk becomes a stash-and-wait play in deep outfits, and Stribling is the cheap gold nobody's panned yet.

stories.headline: Eleven Hundred Fellas Turned Loose and Dallas Threw the Biggest Surprise: Jaydon Blue Waived
stories.read: The great thinnin' is done. Somewhere north of 1,100 men got cut loose gettin' down to fifty-three, claims are due at one o'clock Eastern today, and the loudest shot came out of Dallas. Jaydon Blue, a fifth-rounder who led the Cowboys in preseason rushin' yards, got waived clean out of the barn after Malik Davis beat him for the number two job behind Javonte Williams. Two reads here: Davis is now the spare horse saddled behind a fella with a long injury history, and Blue is worth a late flier the second some backfield-hungry outfit claims him.
